name: Claid.ai
summary: Product photo editing and generation for e-commerce.
description: Claid.ai automatically enhances product photos: background removal, generated backgrounds, lighting fixes, upscaling and marketplace-ready sizing. It's available as a web app and via API for whole catalogs.

summary_fr: Retouche et génération de photos produit pour l'e-commerce.
